about: Lord voice lines for Oathbound. Rendered with Breeze-TTS-2 by tools/voice/render.py (WSL), built to public/audio/voice/<lord>/<event>_<n>.webm by tools/voice/build.py. Every voice is designed from the text description below; no reference audio of any real person is used. Licence: see docs/AUDIO.md (Voices).

events.taunt: A taunt to the rival across the field, relishing it.
events.deploy: A short, crisp acknowledgement of an order.
events.charge: Shouting a battle cry over the noise of an army.
events.ability: Calling out a powerful ability with full force.
events.roundLost: Grim but unbroken after a lost fight.
events.keep: Urgent alarm, the fortress is under heavy attack.
events.legendary: Impressed and admiring, holding a rare treasure.
events.victory: Triumphant and proud, the war is won.
events.defeat: Defeated and heavy, but keeping dignity.

marshal.name: Marshal Aldric
marshal.voice: A man in his late fifties with a deep, low-pitched baritone voice and a refined southern English accent. A seasoned knight-general: calm, steady and noble, speaking in a low register with warm chest resonance and quiet authority. Natural and grounded, never shrill, not theatrical.
marshal.reference_text: I have held this line through winter and fire. Stand with me, and no banner of ours will ever fall.

pick: Aldric of the Marches. The line is mine to hold.
taunt: Lay down your banners. I'll see they're folded with honour.
ready: The line is drawn. We are ready.
charge: Steady, steady. Now! Take the field!
ability: On my banner! Strike as one!
roundWon: The field is ours. See to the wounded.
roundLost: We fell back. We did not break.
keep: The keep is under siege! To the walls!
legendary: A blade worthy of a king.
victory: Victory. Let the bells ring in every village.
defeat: The field is lost. But not the oath.

archmage.name: Archmage Sefa
archmage.voice: A composed woman in her forties with a cool, smooth alto and crisp, precise English diction. Wry, dry and quietly menacing, unhurried and faintly amused, as if she already knows how this ends. Controlled and intimate, never shouting, with an otherworldly calm.
archmage.style: Cool, wry, crisp and quietly menacing.

delivery.charge: Cold and quietly relishing it, unhurried, never shouting.

archmage.reference_text: Magic is only patience with a sharper edge. Sit still, and I shall show you exactly how the stars fall.

pick: Sefa. Do try to keep up.
taunt: I've read how this ends. You won't enjoy the last page.
charge: Let them come to the fire.
ability: The sky is falling. On you.
roundWon: Ash and quiet. Just how I like it.
keep: Someone is knocking on my tower. Rudely.
legendary: Oh, this one hums. I'll keep it.
victory: Checkmate. It was never in doubt.
defeat: Well. I shall remember your name.

warden.name: Warden Hrolf
warden.voice: A huge old Nordic chieftain with a very deep, gravelly bass voice and a strong Scandinavian accent. He speaks slowly and deliberately, booming and resonant, rough-throated and heavy, like a giant warrior speaking in a stone hall.
warden.style: Very deep, gravelly, slow and booming.
warden.reference_text: My fathers built this wall from stone and stubbornness. Many have come to break it. None of them went home.

taunt: Come, little one. Break yourself on me.
charge: Shields up! Forward, slow and sure!
ability: Bulwark! Behind me, all of you!
roundLost: We bend. We do not break.
keep: They hammer at my hall! Hold the gate!
victory: The wall stands. The wall always stands.
defeat: The wall has fallen. Sing of it.

skylady.name: Skylady Ione
skylady.voice: A young woman in her twenties with a bright, clear, energetic voice and a lively Irish accent. Fierce, quick and exhilarated, a little breathless with excitement, like a daring sky-rider captain calling to her squadron over the wind.
skylady.reference_text: There's nothing like it, the wind in your face and the whole world down below. Hold on tight, we're going up!

pick: Ione of the high wind! Let's fly!
taunt: You'll never see me coming. Nobody ever does.
ready: Saddled and ready! Give the word!
keep: They're at the keep! Wheel around, now!
legendary: Oh, would you look at that shine!
victory: The sky is ours! Every last cloud!

lich.name: Lich-Priest Morthen
lich.voice: An ancient undead priest with a dry, hollow, rasping male voice, low and breathy, half-whispered yet resonant, as if speaking from inside a tomb. Measured, cold and archaic, every word slow and precise, with no warmth at all. Clear and intelligible.
lich.style: Dry, ancient, cold and measured, half-whispered.

delivery.charge: Cold and commanding, a low intoning call, never shouting.
delivery.ability: Intoning a dark rite with slow, rising force.

lich.reference_text: I have stood at the edge of the grave for a thousand years. Kneel now, and you may yet serve me after death.

taunt: Every soldier you bring is one more for me.
roundLost: Death is patient. So am I.
keep: They claw at my sanctum. Defend it.
legendary: Old power. I can taste it.
defeat: I will return. I always return.

sultana.name: Sultana Zahira
sultana.voice: A regal woman in her forties with a warm, rich, commanding mezzo voice and a light Arabic accent. Poised, proud and measured, speaking like an empress addressing her court: gracious, but utterly certain. Clear, resonant and dignified.
sultana.reference_text: The desert taught my people patience, and the sun taught us pride. Stand with me, and you will never kneel again.

pick: Zahira, Sultana of the Sun. Kneel, or ride with me.
taunt: The sun rises on my empire. It sets on yours.
ready: My court is assembled. We are ready.
ability: Let the sun heal the faithful!
roundWon: Well done. The court is pleased.
roundLost: A cloud passes. The sun remains.
Remember this. We will repay it.
keep: My palace is under siege! To the gates!
legendary: A treasure fit for my throne.
victory: Bow to the sun. It is over.
defeat: Even the sun must set. For tonight.

deathknight.name: Lord Vaelric the Death Knight
deathknight.voice: A cursed knight risen from the grave: a deep, heavy, iron-hard male voice in his forties, cold and grim, a low growl with a faint metallic rasp as if speaking from inside a closed helm. A hard northern English accent, slow and menacing, every word a verdict. Clear and intelligible.

delivery.charge: A grim, heavy war cry from deep in the chest, forceful but never shrill.

deathknight.reference_text: I swore an oath to my king, and I kept it past my own death. Now my blade serves only the grave.

pick: Vaelric, sworn in death. My blade still remembers.
taunt: Run if you like. The grave is patient, and so am I.
ability: Feed on them! Take their souls!
roundWon: A good harvest. Gather the fallen.
roundLost: Death is no stranger to me.
We will rise again. We always do.
keep: They breach the crypt! Hold them!
legendary: This steel hungers. I know the feeling.
victory: Kneel. Your kingdom belongs to the grave.

ossuary.name: Gorrath the Ossuary Warden
ossuary.voice: A colossal giant built of fused bone and iron: an extremely deep, slow, cavernous bass male voice, rumbling and hollow like stones grinding in a tomb. Ancient and simple, he speaks in short blunt words with long pauses, heavy and calm. Clear and intelligible.
ossuary.style: Cavernous, very deep, slow and blunt.

delivery.charge: A slow, earth-shaking roar of a command.

ossuary.reference_text: I am the wall of bones. A thousand warriors built me, and a thousand more will break upon me.

pick: I am the warden of the bones. None pass.
taunt: Little things. I will build a wall from you.
keep: The walls! They are at the walls!

drakerider.name: Queen Nyssara the Bone Drake Rider
drakerider.voice: An undead queen in her thirties: a cold, silken, haunting female voice, a low alto with a whispery chill and a refined eastern European accent. Proud, cruel and graceful, half-smiling as she speaks, savouring every word. Clear and intelligible.

delivery.charge: A cruel, exultant cry over rushing wind, sharp but controlled.

drakerider.reference_text: My kingdom died, so I took a dragon from its grave and made the sky my throne. Look up, and kneel.

pick: Queen Nyssara rides again. Look up, and despair.
taunt: Such pretty soldiers. They will rot beautifully.
ready: My drake is hungry. Let us begin.
ability: Breathe, my drake! Let them rot!
roundLost: A setback. Queens do not bleed.
keep: My keep! Drive them from my walls!

vizier.name: Grand Vizier Kasim the Djinn-caller
vizier.voice: An elderly court sorcerer in his seventies: a thin, reedy, slightly nasal tenor male voice with a Persian accent, sly, silky and theatrical, savouring every word, a schemer's soft chuckle beneath it. Unhurried and clever. Clear and intelligible.

delivery.charge: Gleeful and sly, urging his servants on, raised but never a full shout.

vizier.reference_text: Every lamp holds a servant, and every servant holds a secret. Rub gently, my friend, and the desert will answer.

pick: Kasim, Grand Vizier. My lamp is never empty.
taunt: You fight with steel? How charmingly old fashioned.
deploy: A small move. A clever one.
ability: Winds of the desert, obey me!
keep: The palace! Someone defend the palace!
legendary: Oh, now this is a treasure.
victory: Wisdom wins, as it always does.

rajah.name: Rajah Bahadur the Elephant Lord
rajah.voice: A heavyset man in his sixties with a very deep, low, rumbling bass-baritone voice and a warm Indian accent. He speaks slowly and grandly from deep in the chest, relaxed and hearty, with a low chuckle, like a great lord at ease on the back of his war elephant. Low-pitched, never shrill, never shouting. Clear and intelligible.
rajah.reference_text: My grandfather rode this elephant, and his grandfather before him. Make way, little ones. The river kingdom is marching.

pick: Bahadur, lord of the river kingdom! Make way!
taunt: My elephant has stepped on bigger armies than yours.
ready: Sound the drums! We are ready!
roundWon: Ha! Did you see them run?
A fine day. Feed the elephants.
roundLost: We will come back twice as heavy.
keep: They are at my gates! Shut the gates!
legendary: Gold and glory! I love it!
victory: Victory! Tonight we feast for a week!
defeat: Even the mightiest beast must fall.

delivery.charge: A deep, booming roar from the chest, low and hearty, never shrill.
delivery.ability: A deep, booming command from the chest, low and powerful, never shrill.

rocrider.name: Amira Falconheart the Roc Rider
rocrider.voice: A young desert archer-warrior in her twenties: a clear, keen, focused female voice with a light Arabic accent, quick and calm like a hunter, bright mid-range, confident and a little wry. Natural and grounded. Clear and intelligible.
rocrider.reference_text: From up here the whole desert is a map, and every enemy is a mark. Breathe out, draw, and let the wind do the rest.

pick: Amira Falconheart. My arrows never miss.
taunt: I see you from the clouds. Every single one of you.
charge: Up, up! Strike from the sun!
keep: Our home is burning! Fly back!
victory: The wind carried us to victory!
